## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | yes |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | **none** |

Per organization, and unlike external_evidence (readable by everyone) no API role may SELECT it: RLS is on with no policy and no grant. Reads go through kg_list_entities, writes through kg_upsert_entity and kg_queue_identity_review, each SECURITY DEFINER and each refusing an actor outside the organization (insufficient_privilege) or no actor at all — the organization check is kg_assert_org_member, and a super admin may read any graph. Audited at tier 3 by the three statement-grain triggers (rehearsal/960 proves the row names the actor). Outside the simulation: no engine input and no graph-hash scope reads it (PLAN.md §29 rule 4).

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.
